In this paper, a Recurrent Neural Network (RNM) in particular with the Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) techniques used for advanced analysis of predicting the temperature. The performance of LSTM NN was measured using root mean square error (RMSE) and the results show the model is significantly more accurate.

articleTitle: Reduction of False Positives in Identification of Masses in Mammograms
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Breast cancer has become one of the prevalent diseases in this era among women. Although breast cancer is a fatal disease, patients still have high chances of survival if detected at an early stage. The use of computer aided diagnosis (CAD) systems could provide an objective solution compared to qualitative solutions by radiologists. Many cases are getting resulted as false positives that the patients without cancer are sent to diagnostic mammography, on the other hand, patients with breast cancer are sent back saying that there is no cancer growth due to the inaccuracy which results in cancer enormously. In order to overcome this problem, a machine learning-based system is designed that can analyze the mammogram output and can predict whether the patient is developing cancer or not. To this end, a unique descriptor, namely Local Neighbourhood Intensity pattern (LNIP) is proposed for suspicious region representation. Experiments on DDSM database employing 2000 suspicious regions with support vector machine (SVM) classifier, demonstrate the efficiency of proposed system. The obtained result significantly reduces false positives achieving an accuracy of 97.5%.

articleTitle: Single-Gateway Multi-Node Mesh Network for a Connected Electric Vehicle Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A connected electric vehicle ecosystem can provide us with many benefits such as Better Range prediction, Over the air updates, Collision detection, Vehicle tracking and Traffic law enforcement. At the same time connecting every vehicle to the internet can turn out to be very costly, as each node may require its own internet connection which will be a repetitive cost depending upon the particular ISP providing the service. Using a mesh network of a single gateway and multiple nodes, can bring down the price of implementing such a system.

articleTitle: Topic Identification for Semantic Grouping based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Topic identification is a research initiative, that aims at techniques for the easy extraction of required news events. Unstructured news data is in the form of Natural Language, which is a challenge to identify the topics of the same events. It has structural and lexical ambiguity which makes it difficult to correlate and extract the information. In our work to make Information Extraction in news events efficient, an approach is proposed where Parts of Speech (POS) Tagging and Named Entity Recognition (NER) is used. Python library spacy uses Hidden Markov Model (HMM) and Conditional Random Fields (CRF) to identify the 16 NER tags. Accuracy of 16 tags is also discussed. In this way, in future, two or more events can be correlated and can get to know information related to specific news events.

articleTitle: Ensuring Anomaly-Aware Security Model for Dynamic Cloud Environment using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cloud concepts such as resource sharing, outsourcing, and multi-tenancy create significant challenges to the security community. Also, trusted third party and web technologies based cloud service provisioning arises new security threats in the cloud environment. Cloud security research still faces the shortcomings in improving the detection accuracy and detecting the new or unknown attacks in the cloud. Machine learning techniques play a significant role in automatically discovering the potential difference between legitimate and malicious data with high accuracy. Hence, it is essential to develop an intelligent security mechanism to learn, adapt, and detect the attacks or anomalies for the distributed and dynamic cloud environment. This work is about security solutions developed by a new mechanism called transfer learning techniques for the cloud environment. The transfer learning model leverages the detection of different types of known and unknown attacks by the utilization of the knowledge from the source domain. Rather learning about the attack from scratch, transfer learning focuses on the transfer of knowledge from source trained attacks to target attacks. This work gives a scope of detecting and solving new attacks on target to be only trained and fix it on the source and maintains qualitative performance.

articleTitle: Power Computation and Performance Analysis of Viterbi-Decoder Using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Utilization of error rectifying codes has demonstrated to be a compelling method to conquer information corruption in advanced correspondence channels. Convolution encoding with Viterbi unravelling is a ground-breaking strategy for forwarding blunder revision. Convolutions codes are one of the most generally utilized divert codes in reasonable correspondence frameworks. These codes are created with a solid scientific structure and are fundamentally utilized for ongoing error revision. Convolution codes convert the whole information stream into one single codeword. The encoded bits depend on the present info bits as well as on past information bits. The principle deciphering procedure for convolution codes depends on the broadly utilized Viterbi calculation. Convolution coding with Viterbi disentangling has been the transcendent FEC method utilized broadly in various applications to accomplish dependable information move, including computerized video, radio, versatile correspondence, and satellite correspondence. The goal of this undertaking is to structure and execute a convolution encoder of rate 1/3 and requirement length 5 and Viterbi decoder of rate 1/3 and imperative length 5 on FPGA equipment. The work additionally incorporates structuring a clamor module from which commotion can be presented in the encoded information for testing purposes. All modules are structured utilizing VHDL programming language and execute utilizing FPGA board. Programming Using FPGA is utilized to help power computation and performance analysis of Viterbi-Decoder.

articleTitle: Overview on CDMA networks and Implementation of CDMA Spread Spectrum Techniques using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In Wireless Networks, there are several techniques that are under consideration for channel access, few of them are CDMA (code division multiple access) and OFDM. Both these techniques are useful in fixing wireless connections to rural areas with good speed accessibility. The orthogonal code accessing helps in increasing the efficiency of channel, power control schemes, path loss prediction empirical models and near far effect helps in maintaining signal strength. With help of these wireless connectivity techniques network connections are possible effectively in rural areas also. Gold, kasami, Walsh Hadamard codes are well known orthogonal pn(pseudo-noise) sequences used in CDMA. This technique has importance in new generation networks. MATLAB Simulink helps in analyzing CDMA working in different spread spectrum techniques.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Backward Pumped Raman Amplifier based DWDM System at 40Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The rigorous requirement for enhanced data transmission and bidirectional communication has led to the usage of WDM system. In this paper, DWDM system in the region 191.1 THz to 193.45 THz at 0.4 nm channel spacing using Raman amplifier is being designed. The data rate used in our work is 40 Gb/s. The Raman Amplifier is used in the backward pump configuration and is having two pumps lasers. The total length span employed in the proposed system is 50 Km single mode fiber, 10 Km dispersion compensation fiber and 10 Km Raman amplifier. The feasibility of the proposed system is examined in terms of Q-factor which should be above 6 to ensure better transreception.

articleTitle: Gait Energy Image Projections based on Gender Detection using Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Ascertaining the gender of a person has a eminent role in many social interactions. Recognition of gender gives positive outcomes in certain applications like the interaction of human and computer, scrutinizing systems, Demographic research. Biological and Gait dependent are two possible cases of gender perception. Due to the distinctive advantages of gender perception based on gait, such as non-invasive, non-contact and obtained easily at a distance, there is an increase in the curiosity in researchers in the perception of gender-based on gait. In the proposed work, the first procedural step is determining Gait energy image projection model(GPM) which is our new proposed descriptor for gender perception and in the second step; the proposed descriptors are merged with the better existing ones such as GEI, Gait Entropy Images, Dynamic Gait Energy Image (D-GEI), Gradient Gait Energy Image (GGEI) to enhance the performance. Finally, for classification, the SVM classifier is given to the proposed descriptors for differentiating the gender. The OU-ISIR database and CASIA datasets are considered for the gender evaluation and comparison of different performance evaluation parameters like recall, precision along with accuracy.

articleTitle: Wi-FI Cloud server based User Operated Billing System in Mall
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In today's world due to the increasing population, the shopping malls are fully crowded and billing is a time-consuming process. The time spend for every customer for billing, because of existing billing technology at the billing counters is more. Human resource required for billing and rechecking work is more. To reduce the time in queue for customer and mall management costs, the idea called “User Operated Billing System in Mall” is originated. The proposed system consists of application software connected with the supermarket web online cloud server. The barcode on every product helps in retrieval of information associated with a particular product by scanning and displaying the same on the smartphone screen. Facility to calculate the total bill amount is done by the server. Customers are provided with the option to pay the bill at the billing counter by cash or directly pay using online payment methods. RFID tagging with each product is providing security. When the customer makes the payment for a particular product, the RFID tag of that product is disabled. But if a customer is checking out without paying for the product, then that product is detected by the RFID reader at the exit.

articleTitle: Automatic Braking System for Two Wheeler with Object Detection and Depth Perception
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A tremendous growth in motorcycle traffic has occurred during the last decades in most developing countries and economically weak nations of the world. Road safety is a challenging aspect for two-wheeler users. In the face of this unfortunate aspect of motorcycle riding, it seems necessary to fully understand the dangers that users face, when traveling by two-wheeler and especially in an urban area. The goal of this paper is to implement an automated braking system. A camera is used to record the view in front of the user. Further, it is processed by using various machine learning algorithms to get the desired input for a brake control system. Algorithms used in this paper to process the images and videos are the YOLO object detection model and the mono depth model. They are used to detect the relative distance between the user and other vehicles and assist the user to apply the brake if there is a possibility of collision or accident.

articleTitle: Compact MSL Filter Using Meander Line Resonator
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper introduces a simple design for implementing a compact Microstrip line filter with band stop characteristics. Filter characteristics are achieved by using meander line as slot in the microstrip line. This perturbs the current through the line leading to the band stop characteristics in the frequency spectrum. As the iterations in the meander line is increased the filter gets tuned for different frequencies. A meander line incorporated microstrip filter with two iterations is fabricated to verify the simulated results. The proposed band stop filter can be widely used in military and medical applications for better efficiency.

articleTitle: Methodology for Detecting Glitch on Clock, Reset and CDC path
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, an attempt has been made to propose a methodology for detecting glitch on clock tree, reset trees, and clock domain crossing (CDC) paths. These glitches, if not verified appropriately, will cause chip re-spins when detected late in the design cycle. Modern designs contain multiple IPs from different sources, and when they are integrated, glitch prone logic can be introduced unintentionally. At the same time, CDC paths with multiplexers or combinational logic are prone to glitch defects being introduced by synthesis. These glitches may be captured by a register when crossing clock domains, causing a functional failure. So, it becomes essential to catch glitch issues in the design in an early phase of the design cycle.

articleTitle: Design of Multiplier with Dual Mode Based Approximate Full Adder
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The CSL (Carry Select) adder is among the best adders to perform adequate arithmetic operations for several architectures. The structure of the CSL adder is so significant that it tends to decrease area, delay and power usage. The CSL adder structure is such that the area, delay and power consumption will be further minimized. It has the ability to vary between the approximate and exact modes of the operation. The CSL adder area, delay and power are reduced with quick, successful gate-level adjustments. Multiplier is used as an essential component in digital signal processing to perform arithmetic operations. The dual mode can provide a multiplier an efficient utilization, where accuracy can change significantly during execution. To provide a smaller area and delay using an effective proposed adder in the multiplier with exact mode and approximate mode. The Dynamic Accuracy Configurable Multiplier is used in contrast with their multiplier, approximate multiplier provides lower delay and higher power with respect to fee of littler accuracy. The parameters with the best grade approach. Apart from exact Evaluation of the 32_Bit multiplier can be simulated and synthesized with the help of the Square-Root (SQRT) CSL adder in XILINXISE. Using 4:2 compressors, the parameter result indicates lower delay, higher power consumption and high speed.

articleTitle: Efficient Motion Compensation and Detection Algorithm using Modified Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Motion compensation and detection from video sequences are widely used in various real time applications such as security and surveillance, etc. In this paper, efficient motion compensation and detection algorithm is proposed which is mainly based upon the Modified Kalman filtering technique to detect and compensate the movement of objects present in the frames. The shadow effect is removed by thresholding operation after Blob detection. To compensate for the camera motion, the basic Kalman filter equation is modified by incorporating two dimensional motion vectors. The comparison result shows that the proposed algorithm can detect and correct movement more efficiently than existing.

articleTitle: Securing Sensitive Data in Body Area Sensor Network Using Blockchain Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Body Area Network which comes under Sensor network is a continuously evolving technology, Which is very helpful in current health care system. One of the crucial specifications in the present health care system is to protect the prosperity parameters like pulse rate (BPM), Electro encephalogram(EEG), Blood pressure, respiration (SPO2) of an individual which are collected from body Sensors against potential adversaries. Thus, the collected sensor data is aggregated and stored in personal server. So, Its' important to have a secure data ingress mechanism. Introducing Blockchain to our concept maintains integrity of the system. Hence this paper considers Blockchain for securing the aggregated sensor data from being tampered.

articleTitle: Real Time Turbidity Measurement in Sludge Processing Unit by using IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: As a vital resource for lifestyles on this planet, Water is under extreme danger of scarcity with population growth. Recycling and reuse of wastewater are constantly important that allows you to fulfill the need for water. Here, the main focus is on designing and developing a turbidity sensor which is of low cost for monitoring the quality of water in the Activated Sludge Process. A photoresistor and a LED will form a turbidity sensor pair. In this project, we are using Series of these turbidity pairs which are placed at different equally spaced positions in a settlement tank. Sensors will monitor and sends the obtained values to the stakeholders over the Internet. A turbidity sensor is not a solution because it is susceptible to changing water conditions and it must be constantly maintained. By introducing the Internet of Things (IoT) concept into this, will help in automating the entire STP process and make it more efficient and cheaper compared to the traditional methods.

articleTitle: An innovative Method of Accessing Digital Video Archives through Video Indexing
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Digital videos are stored in a digital video archive as a collection of records which is kept for future reference. Now, metadata is used for accessing the video files which is stored along with video files separately to enable the users to access these video resources, identifying and managing them efficiently. Each Video document is described by a video metadata about the physical and formal attributes. To access the video files precisely based on a specific topic, the video metadata is not sufficiently able to describe the content of a video document. In this research paper, an innovative method is suggested to access digital video archives for a specific topic of interest using dense captioning videos and indexing. In this proposed method, each video is represented as a script using the video storytelling technique. This script is used for generating an index which is for searching for a particular topic in the video archive. A master index table is used for storing all video indexes in which each keyword points to video file and significant time slots. When the end-user searches for a keyword in a master video index table, he/she will get the details of the video file and time slots which is relevant to the keyword he/she searches.

articleTitle: Design of an Improved Gilbert Mixer for 5G Applications Using 45nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: 5G systems will support the correspondence needs of machine-to-machine and machine-to-human sort applications for making our life more secure and progressively helpful. LNA, mixer, power amplifier are fundamental structure blocks for 5G trans-receiver. Mixer plays an imperative job in RF receiver structure, in which gilbert cell was most regularly utilized mixer since it gives high conversion gain, great port to port isolation and low distortion. The general methods used in the mixer were current bleeding method, switched biasing method, folded cascading method, cross-coupled post distortion method to make a trade-off between forward gain, noise figure and linearity. In mixer for 5G on-chip transformer based topology, linearized trans-conductance stage, derivative superposition technique, trans-impedance amplifier as Intermediate frequency was utilized and they were executed by using 65nm, 180nm technology and their frequency was 27–40 (GHz). The proposed down-conversion gilbert mixer using resistive current reuse with shunt series peaking using 45nm technology in the range 24–28 GHz frequency to improve the conversion gain or forward gain and to reduce the noise figure.

articleTitle: Predicting Clinical Re-admission using Discharge Summaries (PCRUDS)
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Before days in hospitals used to prescribe medicines in paper format. As the technology increasing in most of the fields to make the process easy handling & robust. The hospital clinical notes are digitalized in electronic medical/health record (EMR) format. This notes which is being very helpful for analyzing for future predictions. The data is created by combing the covid-19 issues and MIMIC-I to predict the re-admission cases through NLP (Natural language processing) techniques. In this paper implemented covid-19 possibility of re-admitting due to some symptoms like fever, cold etc. in histogram form. Used MIMIC-III database which consists of free text in unstructured form and converting in to structured form using natural language processing (NLP) technique and python flask to make a web-app which identifies important keywords and probable diagnosis from the data.

articleTitle: “Nutri-Mental” ─An Android Application For Personal Health And Nutrition Management
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: These days, people are getting more wellbeing cognizant and will, in general, keep a beware of the dietary addition from the stuffed sustenance things they use. The rising growth of Android in the field of Operating System's has brought many advancements and proficient things such as applications, games and many more but also it leads to many complexities such as Mobile Exploitation done through Kali Software. The rising growth of the Android in the field of Operating System's has brought many advancements and proficient things such as applications, games and many more but also it leads to many complexities such as Mobile Exploitation done through Kali Software. The growth of Applications is increasing day by day. In this paper, the android platform is looked at in much more detail and will understand the future scope of Android and will implement Text To Speech and Vice Versa. This paper proposes an innovative Fitness Tracking app using the Android platform. The app would help the users to maintain a healthier lifestyle and eat more nutritious food. The proposed app gives an insight into nutrition that a person should have by eating a properly balanced diet and will present an outline on further research and development of the application.

articleTitle: Implementation of Improved Inline Deduplication Scheme for Distributed Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The recovery and backup system in which the mechanism involves reproducing and recording information on various cloud servers to retrieve the kind of information a while after, an unforeseen occurrence, using that database. The justification for backup is to restore data and boost information from a past period after the misfortune. The backup structures effectively spread the fragments of each datum document through several servers and create information documents' privacy. Deduction compression techniques may be used, but these application frameworks must be strengthened on volume constraints and record preservation must be enhanced. The eradication code in this text can be detected with test inline deduction and report the restoration to see the backup system better. Different documents, from 1 KB to 100 MB, are checked to verify the system view. Test results suggest, with limited data capacities and recovery of information, that the new system succeeds in its current structure.

articleTitle: A Survey: Mobile Cloud Computing in Education
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A new digital technology that is expected to transform the education sector is Cloud computing. Cloud computing has many advantages like simple sharing, fast deployment, reduced cost and convenient processing. The main goal of this paper is to bring out the impact of Cloud computing on the Education system. Nowadays, the usage of mobile phones is increasing day by day and thus they are becoming an essential part of human life. Mobile phones are a very efficient and portable mode of communication which can be used at any time in any place. Most of the applications in mobile phones are connected to cloud like Google cloud for Gmail, Apple iCloud in iPhones and a few others in the education sector information technology plays a vital role. Due to the increase in the educational resources, there should be an architecture developed which should not only store large amounts of data but also process it. Mobile cloud computing is a new approach in education for both teachings as well as learning. Mobile cloud computing is beneficial to educational institutes to store educational data and to help people to access the data at any time from anywhere.

articleTitle: Harmonic mitigation by shunt passive power filter at voltage source type non-linear load
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The harmonic distortion is a very sensitive issue for all power consumers, causes ill-effects such as an increase in loss and current and thereby reduce the life of equipment. The non-linear loads such as be personal computers, automatic machines, adjustable speed drives, lighting ballasts and other power electronic equipment are the main sources of harmonics. In this work, the harmonic mitigation was done of a computer laboratory by shunt connected tuned passive filters. Computer loads contains a switched-mode power supply (SMPS) in the system that generates harmonics at the input side of power supply due to non-sinusoidal current. The simulation work was carried out by modeling personal computer load and single tuned passive filter designed by equal and unequal method. The attractive results for harmonic reduction has been observed. Design of shunt passive power harmonic filters by using equal and unequal branch VAR can be a simple and cost-effective technique for the mitigation of harmonics.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of Zigzag Transformer in Distribution System for Mitigation of Triplen Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The three-phase four wires low voltage supply system to residential, commercial and production areas in the distribution system is implemented. The different nature of loads connected to the three-wire four-phase distribution system. It can be personal computers, automatic machines, variable speed drives, lighting ballasts and other electronic power equipment, which may produce a nonlinear characteristic cause zero sequence current to flow in the system in the neutral of supply system. This may cause a serious power quality problems, results in reduction. This paper present to reduce the harmonics currents and neutral overloading by using the zigzag transformer. The zigzag transformer is one of the solution to attenuate the neutral current and reduce the zero sequence harmonic currents of the distribution systems.

articleTitle: Code Mixed Question Answering Challenge using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In social media, code-mixed language questions(combination of two distinct languages) is turning into the favored method of expression and communication. In twitter people can go over mixed language where individuals frequently utilize their mother tongue along with English. But question answering systems do not support mixed language. They only work on a single language such as English, French and German. This paper presents an online question answering framework for mixed languages. This system analyzes the user's mixed language query and gives the answer and also presents a contrivance that facilitates decode of English mixed with 3 different Indian languages: Hindi, Telugu and Tamil. The code mixed words will be translated into English to reduce data complexity. Later, featurization is performed on them. Deep learning algorithms such as Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Hierarchical Attention Network (HAN) are used for question classification. Confusion matrix is used as evaluation measure of RNN, HAN. This system is facilitated on the web and in future, it can be used for collecting more code mixed questions and answers data for further improvement.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network-based Detection of Diabetes and its Effects on Vision - A survey
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Millions of people are suffering from diabetes, making it a primary health issue now-a-day. International Diabetes Federation mentioned a fact about Diabetes is that there are about 46.5% of adults whose diabetes is undiagnosed. Once the diabetes is detected and if it is not cured for a longer period then it can mainly affect on eyes, kidneys, skin and heart. In this survey, the effects of diabetes on human eyes are mainly considered. Diabetic retinopathy is the common eye disease which damages the retina resulting in permanent blindness. Detection in an early stage is essential to save the person's vision. It also reduces the workload of ophthalmologist in detection of Diabetic Retinopathy. The paper presents the comparison of SVM, ANN and CNN in diagnosing the lesion of the diabetic

articleTitle: Authentication of Face using Matlab
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The face detection technique is a worldwide used technique which is widely used in many multinational companies and the business purposes also. This gives a clear picture of the correct attendance marking by recapturing the whole face. The office staff is also having the attendance criteria therefore the specification is also necessary for them to apply these criteria in processing the correct flow of the given procedure. Yes, the thumb printing part is considered important for them but the face detection theory is considered more advance and appropriate than the thumb printing technique.

articleTitle: Early Diagnosis of Diabetic Vasculopathy by Thermo-Regulatory Vascular Impairment
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Diabetes is one of the chronic diseases that affect people across the globe. Diabetes will lead to a lot of complications if not treated properly. Diabetic Mellitus is a metabolic disorder which shows elevated sugar levels in the blood over a prolonged period. According to senses taken in 2017, 8.8 % of the adult population worldwide was estimated to be diabetic which would shoot up to 9.9% by 2045, i.e. about 6042 million people would be affected worldwide. If diabetes is left untreated, it may lead to various diseases like diabetic retinopathy, diabetic neuropathy, stroke, and heart attack. Prolonged diabetes results in a vascular impairment which might lead to diabetic complications like diabetic foot, diabetic neuropathy. This work is an effort to study the thermoregulatory behavior of the blood vessels of both diabetic and non-diabetic subjects to understand the thermoregulatory changes due to diabetes and its improvement over the period. For diabetics, if disease management is not efficient, they are subjected to a high risk of developing diabetic vasculopathy. In this work, a method is proposed to find out vascular impairment using the thermoregulatory behavior of peroneal blood vessels. A clinical study was carried out involving six subjects and the result obtained showed an accuracy of 83.2%.

articleTitle: A Modified Three Phase Infinite level Inverter with Improved DC Bus Utilization
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, a modified three phase infinite level inverter with reduced switch count and the pure sinusoidal output voltage is proposed. Proposed three phase infinite level inverter is evolved from the novel four switch infinite level inverter topology. Since the switching frequency is very high the level of output voltage reaches infinity, hence the term Infinite Level Inverter. Since only one inductor and the capacitor is used per phase, the overall size, weight, and thus the cost of the inverter is reduced. No additional filter circuit is needed. The control is very simple with the modified PWM technique. With only one switch per phase operating at high frequency at any time, the switching stress and the switching loss is the minimum possible. The DC bus utilization of the proposed three-phase inverter is high, compared to voltage source inverter with various PWM techniques, making it more suitable for applications with low input voltage energy sources. Further, the DC bus utilization is improved with the third harmonic injection PWM technique. The proposed modified three-phase infinite level inverter is analyzed and the simulation is carried out with resistive and motor load conditions.

articleTitle: Health Care Counselling Via Voicebot Using Multinomial Naive Bayes Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Voicebot bestow the user, the ability of receiving retort within minutes, no matter their geographic location, or the apparatus, they are using to transmission. Data related to the health issues are gathered from medical experts, and all of them are stored on the server side of the system. The software furnished by the system offers answers and solutions for audit and treating patients after combining descriptions of the illness and the symptoms, diagnostics, predictions and prescription. This software will be greatly useful to people to protect them from complication, in this proposed system the Voicebot is used to solve the difficulties facing by people at the time of illness, which influence the health of the person. With all these factors, the Voicebot updates its knowledge base and allows patients to benefit from using it. This designed bot is commonly used for general Health Care. Here the input is given by the user in format of text. This text will be analyzed by Multinomial Algorithm, by which the data are fetched from the Data Base and generates voice response. When examine all these bots, the oddity of the proposed system can get response by both sensory and textual methods. This graces the untaught customers to use proficiently. It bears the whole system in customer's cordial manner. The need of the proposed system is minimum time and energy and can clarify our doubts at any time.

articleTitle: Feature Learning of Image for Unsupervised Texture Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Segmentation in specific image class, texture feature extraction plays a vital role. But is time consuming and difficult, to develop novel technique to select features manually. Adapting features automatically for particular class of images, will be helpful and effective. Thus, proposed work contributes in texture segmentation, in absence of large learning datasets for learning features. The feature learning provides essential piecewise image with constraint feature set of compact jump. It is based on convolution feature learning and segmentation performance respectively. It has been reflected, it is possible to learn features of image patch. The approach is effective and produces better texture segmentation for natural images.

articleTitle: Attribute based Encryption for Improved Multi-Keyword Search in Information Network
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Within Information Networks, proprietors can store their archives over various servers that have been transmitted. The proposed framework also implements TF-IDF, which helps clients place their tests.

articleTitle: Improving Static Characteristics of Infrared Sensor using Soft Computing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper presents the design of an efficient soft computing technique for increasing the accuracy of the Infrared Sensor, by using the Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Neural Networks (NN). The analysis for SVM was done with different functions available and the results are presented. For Neural Networks, the analysis was done with different member functions and different number of. To determine the appropriate model, the model with minimum Root Mean square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) when compared with the sensor's measurements were selected. The results indicate that the Neural Network model could reduce the relative RMSE by a factor of 0.58 and MAPE by a factor of 0.76 which is much greater than the results obtained from Support Vector Machine.

articleTitle: Different Approaches for Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Semantic image segmentation is an emerging task in the field of automation. Its application varies from autonomous driving to medical diagnosis. Semantic segmentation of an image means to label each pixel in that image to a particular class. As an example consider an outdoor street image where there are different objects like car, road, sky, trees, pedestrians etc. After applying semantic segmentation each pixel in the image belonging to the car will have the label car and road will have label road and so on. A recent trend in performing semantic segmentation is by using Convolutional Neural Networks, (CNN), which acted as a catalyst for segmentation. In this paper, a detailed discussion of various approaches for segmentation using CNN has been presented. Also, various datasets and their format and evaluations metrics are discussed. All the approaches discussed are diverse and has its pros and cons. Finally, an application-specific semantic segmentation method using a genetic CNN algorithm for classification task has been proposed. The proposed method has shown improvement in the M<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">iou</sub> score when tested on the CamVid dataset and on a dataset created by combining two small object classification datasets, MNIST and CIFAR10.

articleTitle: Power Conscious Routing Algorithm in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Reduction of power consumption in telecommunication networks is a concerning issue for the information communication technologies (ICT) sector as it consumes huge amount of energy. Recent studies show that enormous rise in demands of network gives non negligible impact on global power consumption issues between 2%-10% and 28% of internet users increase the network traffic to 14Tbps per year. This explosion of internet traffic increases the number and diversity of available applications with better quality of services provided at the user end. Because of this continuous growth in traffic conditions of network the constant increase in power consumption and costing are the real concern of the Internet and more generally of the Information and Communication Technologies. The vitality utilization is getting one of the key difficulties for the ICT business and it is just expected to develop in significance. So as to send and bolster future information correspondence organizes in a monetary and manageable manner, administration and substance suppliers need to address the vitality utilization of their systems as one of their top needs In this article, the principle aim of designing an efficient, affordable and sustainable future optical communication network is focused. In this paper, how energy constraint shapes future networks are examined and therefore presented the concept Power conscious routing (PCR) mechanism. The aim is to introduce the reader to one of the method to save energy and drew their focus to the necessity for energy efficiency in information and communication technology.

articleTitle: Analyzing the FWM at Different Power Levels in the Fiber Optic DWDM System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: To improve the capacity of an optical fiber communication system, the dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) is used. “Dense” means it can bring the wavelength closer together than the wavelength division multiplexing system used before. DWDM's function is to combine and transmit the various signals simultaneously on the same fiber at different wavelengths. Within DWDM, the nonlinear effects are caused by the data rate increase, and the channel spacing decrease. FWM is the nonlinearity that affects the transmitted signal and the overall system performance. In this paper, the four wave mixing on the efficiency of DWDM-based optical fiber communication is examined at different power rates. This paper was designed to simulate the 16-channel dense multiplexing wavelength division (DWDM) method using the simulation software OptiSystem7.0. At the receiver side, the variations in the optical spectrum analyzer, BER, and the Quality factor are examined.

articleTitle: A Proposition for a Low-Cost Effective Attendance Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, a holistic methodology has been followed to gauge the quality of service for real-time attendance system. The experiment was done to compare the performance of an attendance server which will be cost-effective but reliable. To reduce the cost, users are connected to the biometric attendance device with a local server where the data is updated instantly. As a result, the chance of data loss is almost none. The available devices in the market are very expensive whereas our complete system may cost around USD50. On the other hand, most of the devices produce multiple data for a single user on a specific day as the data fetched from the internal memory of the respective device. But our proposed system provides a very well-ordered data for easy tracking of attendance. Moreover, our proposed framework requires a marginal power to drive the whole system. The complete system can be implemented using regular hardware and software at a very low cost.

articleTitle: Prioritization of Parts of a Medical Equipment Using Analytical Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Medical equipments are advancing to remarkable heights with the development in various improvising technologies used to build them. When the equipments are improvising towards next standard, on the other hand maintaining the same becomes complicated. There are various methods followed universally for the maintenance of the equipment so far. In fact, there are types of maintenance which are performed accordingly. In this paper, one of the maintenance types-Preventive Maintenance (PM) is concentrated. It is because preventing a failure or breakdown has various effects such as repair cost, equipment's performance, reliability etc., Also there are many ways in which PM is performed namely with a checklist that include vital parts of the equipment to be maintained. Our idea is to focus on the parts that are mostly failing due to various reasons. This paper provides a new approach for framing an effective Preventive Maintenance checklist with the parts that are more prone to failures rather than considering the vital parts. This objective is achieved by using a Multi-criteria decision making model called Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP). Failures are triggered by initiating events called root causes, The proposed method has been validated using breakdown data collected from Narayana Health (NH) over 7 years along with its service history and action taken upon those breakdowns.

articleTitle: Non Invasive Mindwave Control System For Effectively Monitoring The Neuroprosthetic Hand
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper represents an approach while designing the 3D printed hand for the amputees for fulfilling their daily routine task. It is quite a complex mechanism to deal with brain signals. This paper presents the most affordable technique to measure the signals through low-cost EEG headset. The data from the headset is processed and transmitted to the hardware of the system which uses a certain control mechanism for movement of fingers and hand. This type of device is used in such patients having neurological disorders such as brain stroke or has lost their limbs in case of fatal accidents. The aim of designing such a Neuroprosthetic hand is to provide natural movement through brain signals and also eliminate the need for any surgery. A Neuroprosthetic hand can be customized for an amputee with their needs and requirements. More natural movement is also a basic requirement on which this proposed model is emphasized So, an efficient alternative approach is implemented here to design such noninvasive, efficient, affordable solutions for an amputee.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Anti Tremor Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a neurological disorder and also commonly known as tremors, which are caused due to damage in the central nervous system of the brain. Tremors are partially curable with the help of either medication or surgery. As tremors can't be cured completely, researchers are finding ways to reduce the effects of tremors like posture, writing, eating. This paper gives the insight view of mechanisms that are developed to reduce the effects of tremors to date. Reduction of tremors and implementation of devices are analyzed based on their metric system and mechanisms used which can further be developed by overcoming the limitations and reduce the effects of tremors.

articleTitle: Edge Detction Using Block Processing and Lookup Table
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In present generation there is rapid trade on Edge detection in the image processing in extracting images, image segmentation and army applications. articleTitle: PV Fed Sliding Mode controlled SEPIC converter with Single Phase Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The main objective of this work is to effectively utilize solar energy. The output of a photovoltaic system is given to the sliding mode controlled SEPIC converter, to operate PV panel at maximum power point. A second order SMC is also used to control pulses of single-phase inverter and the regulated 230V 50Hz AC signal is obtained which is supplied to a resistive load. The application of SMC at both ends allows efficient operation for changes in weather and load conditions. Conventional MPPT algorithms i.e. incremental conductance, P&O techniques have low tracking efficiency and high oscillations, which may be effectively resolved using sliding mode control (SMC). It is perceived from the analysis that SMC controls the voltage more efficiently with higher value and less fluctuations as compared to conventional methods. The statistical analysis in terms of mean voltage, standard deviation of voltage and mean power also prove the superiority of proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Validation of Response by Classifying EEG Gathered from Different Areas of the Brain
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper uses EEG data collected while conducting a visual search experiment where 31 participants were asked to look for a target in a pool of 63 distractors. Each participant was provided with 300 different trials and in each trial the target was hidden in a randomly chosen position. In this paper artificial neural network (ANN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) models are applied for recognition and classification of electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns associated with correct or incorrect detection of targets. This paper provides a comparison between EEG signals captured from different lobes, or areas of the brain [pre-frontal (Fp), frontal (F), temporal (T), parietal (P), occipital (O), and central (C)] to see which can provide more accurate prediction of a participant's response for target in a visual search experiment. It has been showed that the data taken from a certain portion of the brain improved the LSTM model and ANN Model by more accurately predicting if a participant has provided correct or incorrect response. In future this can help us create BCI (Brain Computer interface) experiments where data taken from specific areas of the brain can help track a participant's performance in a task. In BCI experiments the speed of processing data is of utmost importance and if our models can predict a participant's performance in a shorter time, they can help us improve BCI undertakings.

articleTitle: A Model of Voltage Stabilization Using PWM Inverter at the Load End
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Power system stability is becoming an essential issue to the power system engineers due to the increasing penetration of intermittent RE generations into the electricity grid. The problem of voltage stability in modern power systems is a matter of system limits and voltage failure, which affects the voltage efficiency of the grid. Several vital blackouts caused by the instability of the power system have demonstrated the significance of this phenomenon. Therefore, this paper proposes a new model for improving the voltage stability of the power systems using pulse width modulation (PWM) technique along with voltage source converter and pulse width modulation IGBT inverter. The proposed model is simulated using Matlab Simulink. The results show that even though output voltage fluctuates at 1 second due to the addition of intermittent loads but it can regain its stable position instantly due to the smooth operation of the proposed model. Also, the THD of the output voltage is about 0.52%, which indicates that harmonic distortion reduced considerably.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Data from the Twitter account using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Growth is the part where the mining of the opinion and the analysis can happen and can reach our goal to explore the things on various platforms like opinions or text of social media platforms through machine-learning technology. articleTitle: Secret Key based Sensor Node Security in the Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Security in Internet of Things (IoT) deals with safeguarding connected objects and networks. IoT involves the growing collection of objects known as things with unique identifiers. These objects have the ability to automatically transfer data over a network. Most of the increase in IoT communication comes from computing devices and embedded sensor systems which are used in industrial machine-to-machine (M2M) communication, home and building automation, vehicle to vehicle communication, smart energy grids, and wearable devices. Because the idea is to connect all physical objects to Internet, security has not always been measured in product design. The IoT products fail to select sufficiently strong security. Therefore, security is one of the important factors in IoT that should be taken care on priority basis. This study proposes IoT architecture which deals with security of devices. The main aim of this study is to make sure that an authentic device uploads the data and restrict false data being uploaded by devices trying to be an authentic device. The study presents a strong authentication technique based on secret keys which protects the identity of IoT devices in the network. The authentication and authorization techniques presented in this paper ensure that the right data is sent and received by right devices at right places and for right purpose.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Data Gathering Scheme in Underwater Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, an energy routing algorithm, called SAODV(secure Ad hoc On Demand Distance Vector) is designed for ad hoc mobile networks. SAODV is capable of both unicast and multicast routing. It is an on demand algorithm, meaning that it builds routes between nodes only as desired by source nodes. It maintains these routes as long as they are needed by the sources. Additionally, SAODV forms trees which connect multicast group members. The trees are composed of the group members and the nodes needed to connect the members. Extensive simulations are conducted to study the power consumption, the end-to-end delay, and the network throughput of our protocols compared with existing protocols. Efficiently handling losses in wireless environments, therefore, has significant importance. Even under benign conditions, various factors, like fading, interference, multi-path effects, and collisions, lead to heavy loss rates on wireless links.

articleTitle: Optimizing Resource Utilization by Vm Migration Among Virtual Machines of a Cloud Server
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In a cloud data center server, there could be many physical machines connected as clients. Each physical machine can hold multiple virtual machines. The effective working of the system is determined majorly on the parameters such as the utilization of the system which depends upon resource utilization by single Virtual Machine and Physical Machine resource utilization in total. To optimize the utilization, it is crucial to fetch the data, take the decision considering the situation, and finally take action by migrating the VM to decide the PM if needed. To automate this process and to make such decisions, it is necessary to appoint a monitor machine which can monitor the VM and PM individually, take and implement the actions needed. However, the monitor machine must implement multi-objective optimization thus considering other factors as well such as Qos, Energy saving, and reduction of time and distance while migrating.

articleTitle: Audit and Analysis of Energy Utilization in Engineering Institution Buildings in Maharashtra
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Energy audits are the easiest way to find the gap between energy supply and demand. Energy audit is a consumption index that normalizes the state of the energy crisis by providing savings plans. Any organization called a large electricity consumer the use of appropriate energy-saving technologies or solutions minimizes energy consumption. Collecting this information provides consumers the idea of improving energy efficiency and reducing costs. Energy control of lighting and management of electrical load audit work was carried out to evaluate energy consumption, therefore energy savings opportunities identified implementing energy-efficient equipment or technologies to be adopted at the institution to minimize the energy consumption. articleTitle: Intelligent control system for the seamless transit of Emergency Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In crowded metropolitan cities of India, numerous people's lives are at stake due to ambulances stuck in traffic. Most of the times, the commuters, themselves stuck, cannot move in these jams to make way for the oncoming ambulances. The purpose of this work is to Design and Develop a IOT based Analytical Framework which will the create a green corridor for Ambulance by keeping the Traffic Personnel aware of the approaching ambulance well in advance and ensuring that no pile up of traffic happens when the ambulance is in that area. In this work, a `pre-informing' centralized control system is designed unlike the existing attempts, where the attempt to clear the traffic is done by on-spot manual traffic clearance techniques by traffic light manipulation. Analytical Framework also suggests the Ambulance Driver nearest suitable hospital according to illness and live traffic conditions so that patients get treatment quicker.

articleTitle: An Approach on Efficient Clustering Technique of High Dimensional Records
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Nowadays very large amounts of data can be created in various domain systems, specifically healthcare systems. It is difficult to analyze the complex large amount of data. Clustering is the concept which is used to put together a collection of similar data in a group. There are many techniques which can handle the large amount of data set to cluster such as K-Means, hierarchical and density-based approaches to analyze the data to improve the decision making capability of data sets. In specifically healthcare domain is the extraction of comprehensible knowledge from medical diagnosis records, which is one of the major challenges. This paper is to highlight the various clustering techniques used in the various domains and the comparisons of the different clustering techniques and discuss about the review of ensemble approach for the clustering of high dimensional records. Finally, Enhanced Design Weighted Mean Shift Ensemble Clustering approach was proposed for clustering the high dimensional records, which is improve the accuracy rate of the clustering results.

articleTitle: Multiplexer Based Logic Gates Design Using Ballistic Deflection Transistors
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, multiplexer based logic gates design is presented using ballistic deflection transistor. articleTitle: Validity of Forensic Evidence using Hash Function
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In any crime scene, the cyber forensics team look out for various evidences. In particular, they seek digital evidences such as surveillance system, hard disk drives, pen drives, and so on. After gathering the necessary evidences, they produce an exact copy of the evidence, called the forensics copy, rather than the original copy. This is done to avoid the destruction of original evidence. During the course of the investigation, the evidences may go through several phases. At any point of time, the investigator must be completely sure that the evidence is the exact same copy of the forensics copy. Hash functions play a very crucial role in this regard. They are used to verify whether the evidence has been subject to some unauthorized manipulation. SHA-1 and SHA-2 has been among the widely used hash functions. But nowadays, SHA-1 is considered weak. Furthermore, although SHA-3 is more secure than its earlier counterparts, it is considered to be slow on general purpose processors and as such, they are not so popular as yet. In this context, this assignment proposes a simple, but effective mechanism to fulfill the needs of cyber forensics using the combined capabilities of hashing functions, along with other cryptography concepts such as SALT.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Dynamic Manipulation System Using Vehicle Density

abstract: This paper proposes an improved approach to maximize the traffic flow by reducing the average queue length and average wait time. articleTitle: A Recurrent Neural Network Model for Spam Message Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 5th International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper presents detection of electronic junk mail called spams using Long Short-Term Memory layers in recurrent neural network.
